notes: Deny all access under /tmp root; allow only per-agent scratch dirs /tmp/agent-<id>/. <id> is the agent's unique session id. Companion rule documented in .agents/skills/tmp-agent-skill/SKILL.md — every /tmp path in skills must resolve under $AGENT_TMP=/tmp/agent-<id>/. Exception: /tmp/compacted.md is allowed for comp-now/comp-use skills (global compact file).
